result.oneSentenceSummary: add_members allows duplicate group members and lacks transaction
result.improvedCode:
def add_members
    group = Group.find(params.require(:group_id).to_i)
    usernames = params.require(:usernames)

    return can_not_modify_automatic if group.automatic

    Group.transaction do
      existing_user_ids = group.user_ids
      usernames.split(",").each do |username|
        if user = User.find_by_username(username)
          unless existing_user_ids.include?(user.id)
            group.add(user)
            existing_user_ids << user.id
          end
        end
      end
    end

    if group.save
      render json: success_json
    else
      render_json_error(group)
    end
  end

judge.titleReason: The title names both parts of the defect: duplicate memberships are not guarded against, and the additions lack a transaction.

    def submit(self, group_key: str, work_item: WorkItem[T]) -> None:
        """
        Submit a work item to the appropriate queue.
        """
